name: Akashima Ayumu
source:
The hero. A young man doomed to clean up [url=/c13883]Yumina[/url]'s messes.

After joining the Debate Club together with [url=/c13883]Yumina[/url], he finds himself the club's errand boy - scouting opponents, guarding the candidate, and generally doing whatever [url=/c13884]Kirara[/url] tells him to. Ayumu has few memories of childhood and no knowledge of his parents. He was raised by a man named Akashima Takehito, who subjected Ayumu to a harsh regimen of martial arts and survival training. One day, Takehito revealed the purpose of Ayumu's training. He was to enter Jinbu Academy and protect [url=/c13883]Midorishita Yumina[/url], a girl whom Takehito claimed would one day save the world. Little did Ayumu know that he would first have to save [url=/c13883]Yumina[/url] from her own bad grades.

“ No way you're dragging me into this! ” 

from [url=http://www.jastusa.com/yumina/ayumu.html]jast website[/url]
